outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic (breast anatomy) plus a classification table, not a plot of data.
Panel B is a conceptual schematic illustrating the study's aims, not a data plot.
Panel C is a schematic illustrating the experimental method (luciferase recording), not a data plot.
Panel D shows idealized illustrative curves representing analysis approaches, not real averaged data requiring individual points.
Panel E shows a stylized example heatmap illustrating the correlation analysis concept, not actual averaged data.
Panel F shows illustrative example growth curves representing the analysis concept, not actual averaged experimental data.
Panel G shows illustrative example dose-response curves representing the analysis concept, not actual averaged experimental data.
Panel H shows illustrative example heatmap/mutation matrix representing the analysis concept, not actual averaged data requiring individual points.
Panel I shows illustrative example PCA/3D scatter plots representing the clustering concept as part of the schematic workflow, not a presentation of averaged real data.
